item.title: Doog w khamen – ذوق و خمن
item.description: This series gathers participants for a blindfolded guessing game where they taste different variations of the same food group and attempt to identify what they are eating.

item.title: MMAnia
item.description: MMAnia is a platform dedicated to mixed martial arts (MMA) enthusiasts, offering the latest news, fight analyses, and event coverage. It serves as a hub for fans to stay updated on the MMA world, featuring insights, interviews, and discussions on the sport’s biggest events and fighters.

item.title: MLM – مُلِم
item.description: MLM shows a deep dive into the different sports represented in KSA, explaining their intricacies and inner workings.

item.title: Unseen
item.description: Unseen, powered by UTURN, is a women’s lifestyle, fashion, and beauty platform empowering young Saudi women. It blends international luxury trends with local talent, highlighting emerging designers and tastemakers through an intimate series featuring inspiring female figures, Unseen aims to elevate Saudi Arabia’s fashion and beauty scene, promoting creativity, inclusivity, and self-expression.

item.title: Saudi Gamer
item.description: Saudi Gamer is a leading platform dedicated to the gaming community in Saudi Arabia. It offers the latest news, reviews, and insights on video games, catering to both casual and hardcore gamers. The platform also provides a space for discussions, events, and tournaments, fostering a vibrant and growing gaming culture in the Kingdom.

item.title: UTURN Sketches
item.description: UTURN Sketches is a collection of creative, humorous short videos that showcase everyday life with a comedic twist. Through relatable scenarios and witty storytelling, UTURN delivers fresh and entertaining content that resonates with audiences across the MENA region.
